fun_facts: Ashton Daniels is from Buford, Georgia, and played high school football at Buford High School.
Against Virginia in 2026, Daniels scored five rushing touchdowns, setting a Florida State quarterback record.
In that Virginia game, he rushed for a career-best 136 yards on 17 carries.
In Florida State’s 2026 season opener, he threw a touchdown pass and ran for a touchdown while passing for 202 yards.
Daniels began his college career at Stanford, where he started for two seasons.
